scope: Private, single-region staging application deployment packages only. No customer, repair, login, session or secret data.

exceptions.reason: Owner-approved omission of WORM/Object Lock for rebuildable deployment packages. Versioning and retention support rollback but do not prevent authorized version deletion.
Owner-approved single-region staging store. No cross-region artifact recovery guarantee; application source and build instructions are maintained separately.
Owner-approved omission of a separate S3 server-access-log bucket for staging packages. API/Lambda logging is not claimed as S3 object-access auditing.

requiredControls: Bucket and object scoped deny of insecure transport
Retain bucket on deletion or replacement
Re-review before production, real customer data or a changed storage purpose
